responsibility: Declares AttrVisitor, the Rust ASTVisitor used by macro expansion to process attributes and conditional compilation across the Rust AST. The interface defines helpers for expanding lists of child nodes, function and closure parameters, generic arguments, where clauses, and trait declarations, plus templated utilities that erase stripped children or replace nodes from MacroExpander fragments, and it exposes the large set of visit hooks needed to traverse items, expressions, patterns, statements, and types during attribute expansion.
same_name_distinction: This header defines the AttrVisitor class surface shared with the rest of gcc/rust/expand: member layout, helper templates for child expansion/erasure, and the full set of visit-method declarations. The matching .cc file provides the per-node attribute-expansion behavior and diagnostics.
